name: OpenUSD
notes: 2026-10-29: Documentation assessment only; no installation, fixture, adapter or third-party rights verified.

install.macos: cd examples/openusd-stage-roundtrip && python3 -m venv output/venv && output/venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

evidence.result: usd-core 26.11 (pxr 0.26.11) authors Xform, Cube, Sphere, material binding, translate samples at frames 0-24, metersPerUnit 0.01, upAxis Y. .usda and .usdc reopen equal to the authored stage (prims, attributes, time samples, metadata). Rerun .usda byte-identical. usdchecker not run: not shipped in the wheel. Python 3.12.2, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: usd-core stage .usda/.usdc read-back equal, rerun .usda byte-identical; usdchecker not run (absent from wheel); no rendering; macOS arm64

license: LicenseRef-TOST-1.0 for the usd-core wheel (Tomorrow Open Source Technology License 1.0); OpenUSD LICENSE.txt is the same licence
summary: OpenUSD is a scene-description framework and interchange ecosystem for composing 3D scene data, with C++ and Python interfaces. Import fidelity varies by application and schema.
use_when: Exchange or compose layered 3D scene descriptions
Investigate a reusable scene interchange route
avoid_when: Need a finished rendered image: Blender
Need small real-time GLB assets: glTF Transform

assessment.rationale: Official sources describe an automation route; release and substantive-commit dates could not be fully established. Keep candidate pending further review.
